title: Introduction & The Mentorship Challenge
narration_script: Breaking into cybersecurity is tough because generic advice fails. Why did the router go to therapy? It had too many unresolved connections. After seven years and hundreds of episodes on Breaking Into Cybersecurity, one truth stands out: effective career coaching requires a personalized strategy tailored to your exact background. Because I cannot personally mentor every candidate one-on-one, I built CyberMentor for the Google Cloud All Things Agentic Hackathon. CyberMentor is a persistent, 24/7 AI cybersecurity career coach built on the Google Antigravity SDK and Google Gemini 3.7 Flash.

title: Interactive Study Plans & Resume Skill Audits
narration_script: CyberMentor delivers structured, actionable guidance rather than generic answers. When you share your background in IT helpdesk, military service, or a non-technical role, the coach generates a weekly study plan for certifications like Security+, CySA+, or CISSP. When you upload a resume, CyberMentor executes an automated skill gap audit aligned with the NIST NICE framework, so you stop phishing for compliments and start mastering the exact competencies hiring managers want.

title: Google Antigravity SDK & Low-Cost Model Routing
narration_script: CyberMentor runs on the Google Antigravity SDK, using explicit tool docstrings for deterministic routing instead of brittle prompt chains. We built a cost-efficient two-tier architecture: Google Gemma 3 27B handles rapid intent classification and skill extraction, while Gemini 3.7 Flash powers deep career reasoning and mock interview evaluations. That keeps your cloud bill safe from a denial-of-wallet attack, while ambient focus audio keeps you locked in.

title: 1,164-Episode RAG Knowledge Base & Voice Coaching
narration_script: CyberMentor is backed by seven years of real-world industry insights. Why do red teamers make terrible secret keepers? Because they always crack under pressure. We indexed over 1,160 Breaking Into Cybersecurity podcast episodes and production briefs into a semantic search engine. Candidates can ask specific career questions and receive verified insights from veteran security leaders. With integrated speech recognition and audio feedback, users can practice technical and behavioral mock interviews hands-free.

title: Zero-Cost Serverless Cloud Run & Call to Action
narration_script: CyberMentor runs completely serverless on Google Cloud Run with persistent cross-session memory in Cloud Firestore. It never forgets your progress, unlike me trying to remember where I left my SSH keys. Experience the live coach today to map your career path, prepare for interviews, and land your next cybersecurity role.
